command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# No python3 in this image: the glue is awk, and the de novo fixture is staged pre-generated.
mkdir -p /tmp/preparsed && chmod 1777 /tmp/preparsed

# bioconda-recipes#70249: HOMER's compiled tools record an RPATH into the conda BUILD env,
# so they find libstdc++ only if the image's base happens to ship one. The library is in the
# env's own lib/; point the loader there. Prefix found from perl, so it is /opt/conda in
# aarchbio's image and /usr/local in bioconda's x86 one -- one spec for both.
PFX=$(dirname "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$(command -v perl)")")")
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$PFX/lib${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
echo "== HOMER's compiled tools must load before anything runs (it exits 0 when they do not) =="
homer2 2>&1 | grep -q "homer2 <command>" \
  || { echo "FAIL: homer2 does not load ($(homer2 2>&1 | head -1)) -- HOMER would exit 0 with empty results"; exit 1; }
echo "homer2 loads (prefix $PFX)"

echo "== staged fixture must match its pins =="
sha256sum -c fixture.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: the de novo fixture does not match its pins"; exit 1; }

echo "== CTCF peaks (macs2) -> 200 bp around each summit, and a control 100 kb away =="
CHRLEN=$(awk '!/^>/{n+=length($0)} END{print n}' chr20.fa)
awk 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} !/^#/ {s=$2+$10; print "p"NR,$1,s-100,s+100,"+"}' peaks.narrowPeak > peaks.txt
awk -v L="$CHRLEN" 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} {if ($4+100000 < L) print $1"_off",$2,$3+100000,$4+100000,"+"}' peaks.txt > offset.txt
NP=$(wc -l < peaks.txt | tr -d ' '); NO=$(wc -l < offset.txt | tr -d ' ')
echo "chr20 length $CHRLEN; peaks $NP; offset control $NO"
test "$NP" -eq 1390 || { echo "FAIL: expected macs2's 1390 CTCF peaks, got $NP"; exit 1; }

T0=$(date +%s)
findMotifsGenome.pl peaks.txt  chr20.fa known_peaks  -size given -nomotif -p 4 -preparsedDir /tmp/preparsed > fmg_peaks.log 2>&1; R1=$?
T1=$(date +%s)
findMotifsGenome.pl offset.txt chr20.fa known_offset -size given -nomotif -p 4 -preparsedDir /tmp/preparsed > fmg_offset.log 2>&1; R2=$?
T2=$(date +%s)
echo "known motifs: peaks rc $R1 in $((T1-T0))s, offset control rc $R2 in $((T2-T1))s"
test "$R1" = 0 && test "$R2" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: findMotifsGenome.pl did not finish"; tail -20 fmg_peaks.log fmg_offset.log; exit 1; }
cp known_peaks/knownResults.txt known_peaks.tsv; cp known_offset/knownResults.txt known_offset.tsv

echo "== de novo: a planted 10-mer, and unplanted control sequences =="
findMotifs.pl targets.fa fasta denovo  -fasta background.fa -len 10 -noknown -p 4 > fm_denovo.log 2>&1; R3=$?
findMotifs.pl control.fa fasta control -fasta background.fa -len 10 -noknown -p 4 > fm_control.log 2>&1; R4=$?
echo "de novo rc $R3, control rc $R4"
test "$R3" = 0 && test "$R4" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: findMotifs.pl did not finish"; tail -20 fm_denovo.log fm_control.log; exit 1; }
head -1 denovo/homerResults/motif1.motif  > denovo_motif1.txt
head -1 control/homerResults/motif1.motif > control_motif1.txt

awk -v PLANT=GATTACAGGT -v RC=ACCTGTAATC '
function ctcf_row(file,   l, n, f) {            # first row whose name starts "CTCF(Zf)/" (vertebrate CTCF)
  n = 0
  while ((getline l < file) > 0) { n++; if (n == 1) continue
    split(l, f, "\t"); if (f[1] ~ /^CTCF\(Zf\)\/CD4/) { close(file); return n - 1 "\t" l } }
  close(file); return "" }
function pct(x) { gsub(/%/, "", x); return x + 0 }
BEGIN {
  getline hdr < "known_peaks.tsv"; getline top < "known_peaks.tsv"; close("known_peaks.tsv")
  split(top, t, "\t")
  printf "known_rank1           %s  logP %s  target %s  background %s\n", t[1], t[4], t[7], t[9]
  ok = 1
  if (t[1] !~ /^CTCF/) { print "FAIL: the top known motif for CTCF ChIP peaks is " t[1] ", not CTCF"; ok = 0 }
  split(ctcf_row("known_peaks.tsv"), a, "\t"); ep = pct(a[8]) / (pct(a[10]) > 0 ? pct(a[10]) : 1e-9)
  split(ctcf_row("known_offset.tsv"), b, "\t"); eo = pct(b[8]) / (pct(b[10]) > 0 ? pct(b[10]) : 1e-9)
  printf "ctcf_in_peaks         rank %d  target %s  background %s  enrichment %.1fx\n", a[1], a[8], a[10], ep
  printf "ctcf_in_offset        rank %d  target %s  background %s  enrichment %.2fx   (control: 100 kb away)\n", b[1], b[8], b[10], eo
  # In regions with no CTCF signal, the motif occurs at about its genomic rate, so enrichment
  # sits near 1x; in CTCF peaks it is an order of magnitude or more. Bounds are set between.
  if (ep < 10) { print "FAIL: CTCF is only " ep "x enriched in CTCF ChIP peaks"; ok = 0 }
  if (eo > 3)  { print "FAIL: CTCF is " eo "x enriched 100 kb away from any peak, so the peak result does not show specificity"; ok = 0 }
  getline d < "denovo_motif1.txt"; split(d, dd, "\t"); sub(/^>/, "", dd[1])
  getline c < "control_motif1.txt"; split(c, cc, "\t"); sub(/^>/, "", cc[1])
  printf "denovo_motif1         %s  logP %s   (planted %s)\n", dd[1], dd[4], PLANT
  printf "control_motif1        %s  logP %s   (nothing planted)\n", cc[1], cc[4]
  if (dd[1] != PLANT && dd[1] != RC) { print "FAIL: de novo motif 1 is " dd[1] ", not the planted " PLANT; ok = 0 }
  if (cc[1] == PLANT || cc[1] == RC) { print "FAIL: the planted motif was found in sequences where it was never planted"; ok = 0 }
  if (!(dd[4] + 0 < 10 * (cc[4] + 0))) { print "FAIL: the planted motif is not an order of magnitude more significant (log p) than the best control motif"; ok = 0 }
  if (!ok) exit 1
  print "HOMER OK"
}' 2>&1 | tee smoke-check.txt
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: a HOMER check failed"; exit 1; }
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
